s.zh: 天空染成了暗红色，诸神的目光投向了这片土地。\n\n接下来的
s.en: The sky turned dark red, and the gods turned their gaze to this land.\n\nFor the next

s.zh: 天里，敌人中的神力灌注者大幅增多（15%），大规模袭击的领队有一半的可能被神明附体；神力的效果也更强。\n\n击退神明附体者会得到神迹残片。
s.en: days, divinely infused enemies increase greatly (15%), leaders of large raids have a one-in-two chance to be possessed by gods, and divine power effects are stronger too.\n\nDriving off the god-possessed yields miracle fragments.

s.zh: 祭司们做了同样的梦：众神在暗红的天幕下争吵。\n\n
s.en: The priests all had the same dream: the gods quarreling under a dark red sky.\n\n

s.zh: 天后，黄昏之年就要开始了。到时候敌人里会出现更多神力灌注者，大规模袭击的领队可能被神明附体。
s.en: days from now, the twilight years will begin. Then more divinely infused enemies will appear, and leaders of large raids may be possessed by gods.
